title: Phone number subscription
description: Represents a single phone number subscribed by an account

account_id.description: The account_id is the account to which the number is currently assigned.

country_code.description: The telephony country code as per ITU standards.

area_code.description: The telephone area code of the phone number

country.description: The country where the number is from.

is_part_of_series.description: A Boolean that specifies if the number is a part of a number series

range.description: Applicable if the phone number subscription is of a number that is a part of a phone number series. The value specifies the quantity of phone numbers in the number series of which this phone number is a part of

city.description: Name of the city where the number is. The name is descriptive and does not follow any standard.

type.description: Type of number – This can be either “national”, “geographic”, or “tollfree”

one_time_fee.description: One-time fee for the phone number charged when it is purchased. Up to 2 decimals.

recurring_fee.description: Current recurring fee for the phone number. Up to 2 decimals

recurrence_interval.description: Current recurrence interval for the recurring fee. Specified in days(e.g. 15d) or months(e.g. 3m).

per_call_fee.description: The per call fee applicable to the number. Up to 2 decimals

per_min_fee.description: The charge per minute fee for calls. Up to 2 decimals

per_sms_fee.description: The per SMS receiving fee applicable. Up to 2 decimals

per_fax_fee.description: The per FAX receiving fee applicable. Up to 2 decimals

currency.description: The currency in which the fee is specified

price_category.description: The price category of the number/series. The allowed values are 1- regular, 2- gold, 3 - gold+, 4 - gold++, 5 -gold+++

connect_to_type.description: The destination to which this number is connected. The supported values are user, phnum, sip,app, csg

connect_to.description: The id of the entity the phone number is connected to. For example, if the number is connected to a user then this is the `user_id`.

activation_date.description: The date/time the number/series was activated.

next_fee_date.description: The date/time that the next recurring fee is to be charged

reclaim_date.description: The date/time an inactive number will be automatically removed from your account if it is inactive due to insufficient balance in the account.

status.description: The number/series status. Can take values “active” or “inactive”

status_desc.description: The text reason specification. Applies in case the number is inactive.

freetest.description: Booleanthat specifies if this subscription is currently under free testing. Takes Boolean values.

branded.description: Flag that specifies whether the number is a branded number i.e. free with the website chat widget.

freeplan.description: Flag that specifies whether the number is included for free with [paid plans](https://sonetel.com/plans).

phnum.description: The number in E164 format without ‘+’

free_test_expiry_date.description: The date/time when the free testing period ends.

sms_settings.description: SMS delivery settings for the number.

plan_details.description: The plan details of the number. Only the `next_renew_mode` can be updated

current_renew_mode.description: This is a readonly property that holds values of 1m,1y,3y. 1m stands for one month, 1y stands for one year and 3y stands for 3 years renewal period

next_renew_mode.description: When the number renews on `next_fee_date` how long should it renew for.

activation_date.description: The date of creation of the phone number subscription.

next_fee_date.description: The date on which the next renewal fee is due.

deactivate_date.description: The date on which the number will be deactivated if your account does not have enough credit to apply the `next_recurring_fee`. This date includes a grace period.

next_recurring_fee.description: The cost of the next renewal. (upto 2 decimals)

show.description: This field lists what to show in the CLI if the phone number is not connected to a user. Valid values are "caller", "called".

rule_set_id.description: The Id of the rule set if exceptions are defined for call processing. This field is empty if no exceptions are defined.

state.description: If the phone number is from USA, then this will hold the name of the state

addr_req.description:
Flag indicating whether there are any address requirements for this number.

These are legal requirements that must be met before the number can be used.

See the address requirements at https://sonetel.com/phone-number-limitations for more details.

addr_proof.description: Flag indicating whether submission of address proof is required for this number. Can take values 'yes', 'no'

access_restrictions.description: Indicates if there are any access restriction from any provider on this number.

restrictions_desc.description: Any additional restrictions applicable on this number.

cli_support.description:
Indicates whethe the phone number can be shown as caller ID (CLI) in calls.

- no  → can never be used for CLI
- yes → number can be used for CLI
- add_on → can be used as CLI with a package

business_pkg_support.description: Indicates whether business package is supported on this number.

package.description: Describes the current package on this number. Available values "regular", "standard", "business"

call_recording_allowed.description: This property indicates whether call recording can be enabled on this number. Available values "yes", "no" "add-on".

voiceapp_connect.description: Indicates whether this number can be allowed to connect to a voice app

csg_connect.description: Indicates whether this number can be allowed to connect to a team.
